name: Iraq (1991–2004)
description: A horizontal tricolour of red, white and black, the white stripe bearing three green five-pointed stars with the takbir 'Allahu Akbar' in green between them, in what was said to be Saddam Hussein's handwriting.
history: The takbir was added to the 1963 flag on 13 January 1991, on the eve of the Gulf War, in a bid for religious support; the script was reputed to be Saddam Hussein's own hand. The Interim Government replaced it with a Kufic-script version on 28 July 2004.

features.role: the takbir 'Allahu Akbar' in handwritten script between the stars
